title: Real-World Safety Profile of Xanomeline-Trospium (Cobenfy) in FDA FAERS: analysis code
description: Reproducibility repository for the disproportionality analysis of xanomeline-trospium (Cobenfy/KarXT) adverse event reports in the FDA Adverse Event Reporting System (FAERS), Q4 2024 to Q1 2026 (six quarterly files). Includes the full pipeline (download, deduplication, RxNorm standardisation, four-method disproportionality battery, active-comparator analyses, Weibull time-to-onset, MGPS refit, sensitivity and validation analyses, signal classification, and figure/table generation).
